mutation_check.clean_state: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 plus rm -rf __pycache__ before and after every trial

D1.question: is the stale-bytecode mechanism what was claimed
D1.mechanism: a timestamp .pyc records source mtime truncated to a whole second plus source size; CPython reuses the cached bytecode while both match, so a mutate-test-restore cycle completing inside one second executes the previous step's bytecode
reproduced_directions: mutant on disk runs original bytecode: mutation falsely SURVIVED
original restored runs mutant bytecode: control falsely FAILING
refinements_not_in_the_original_account: source_size is a partial guard: a mutation that changes byte length is rejected
the restore direction has no such protection because the restored file is always the original's length, so a falsely failing control can follow any mutation
D1.detected_by: the restore-and-run control; direction A alone is silent
D1.permanent_guard: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and rm -rf __pycache__, already in scripts/harness-test
D1.incidental: a stale experiment/harness/__pycache__/pricing.cpython-314.pyc was present at track start, gitignored and untracked, removed
gaps: assert_clean is not yet called by any checked-in sweep driver
the digest comparison excludes co_filename and co_firstlineno
hash-based pyc handling was not exercised against a real one

findings.defect: lo, hi = obs - 0.005, obs + 0.005 with lo <= derived < hi; at observed 0.05 the lower bound evaluates to 0.045000000000000005, above the bound it represents, so a derived total of exactly 0.045 was reported outside an interval it is the endpoint of

orthogonal_open_defect_from_track_b.defect: the interval is half its true width; a difference of two cent-resolution balance readings carries two independent quantisations, so the bound should be plus or minus 0.01 not 0.005

static.site: transport.py and its byte-identical copy t.py
static.defect: a pooled requests.Session that posts to the provider and writes no artifact; documented as the replacement for the curl subprocess, tested, and nothing stopped a future script importing it
static.fix: TestNoModuleReachesTheProviderWithoutPersisting, in the same shape as TestNoScriptBypassesTheRunner: every module with a POST marker is either declared persisting and checked to write both artifacts and carry the raise, or quarantined and checked to persist nothing, and no non-test module may import a quarantined one
